# Read dataset, summarize data for each CoupleID and add nessesary information
```{r}

## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Combined_dataset_Europe.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Convert as factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (1053 rows)
merged_data <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, MaleAge, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(prop = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr)

merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr)

# Add nessesary information to the data frame
# Add column female and male infection status
## Define infected and uninfected categories
infected_categories <- c("Par6", "Bal", "Rennes", "Trento", "Am^Bal", "Am^Trento", "Am^Rennes", "Am^Par6")
uninfected_categories <- c("Am", "Mon47", "Par7", "BalT", "RennesT", "TrentoT")

## Apply the function to both females and males
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate (FemaleInfect = get_infection_status(Female, infected_categories, uninfected_categories)) |>
  dplyr::mutate (MaleInfect = get_infection_status(Male, infected_categories, uninfected_categories))

## Check the infection status of each strain is assigned
merged_data[is.na(merged_data$FemaleInfect),]

# Add column description of cross
merged_data <- merged_data |>
dplyr::mutate(Cross = as.factor(determine_cross(MaleInfect, FemaleInfect)))|>
dplyr:: mutate(Cross = factor(Cross, levels = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-", "Test cross W- x W+", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+")))

# Add information about number of Couples For each CrossType
##Count the number of couples per CrossType
cross_count <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Couple_count = dplyr::n())

##Create a new label combining CrossType and the number of Couples
cross_count <- cross_count %>%
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = paste0(CrossType, " " ,"(", Couple_count, ")" ))

## Merge the new labels with the data
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::left_join(cross_count, by = "CrossType")

## Add column Test vs. control cross
merged_data <- merged_data |>
dplyr:: mutate(CI_test = as.factor(ifelse(Cross=="Test cross W- x W+", "Test_cross","Control_cross")))

## Export file with hatch rates per Couple_ID
write.table(x = merged_data, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

## 16 zeros out of 272 Petri dishes
## With 2–3 observations per couple, the data barely separate the random coupleID from the zero inflation (i.e. “this couple has a low mean” from “this couple had chance structural zeros”).
z <- with(merged_data, tapply(prop == 0, CoupleID,
                           function(v) paste0(sum(v), "/", length(v))))
table(z)
sum(merged_data$prop == 0)
nrow(merged_data)

```

# Check structure
## Check structure of model with zero inflation with aggregated data
```{r, eval=TRUE}
## Load aggregated data
merged_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

# Subset the data with a single type of cross (with Bal line)
dat <- merged_data[merged_data$Female%in%c("Am", "Bal")&merged_data$Male%in%c("Am", "Bal"), ]
#dat <- merged_data[merged_data$Female%in%c("Am", "Par6")&merged_data$Male%in%c("Am", "Par6"), ]

## Binomial models
msat_bin_nozi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~0 , family=binomial)

msat_bin_zi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 , family=binomial)

msat_bin_zi_CrossType <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 +CrossType, family=binomial)

## Beta-binomial models
msat_betabin_nozi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~0 , family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())

msat_betabin_zi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 , family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())

msat_betabin_zi_CrossType <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 +CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())

msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(sum_larvacount, sum_eggcount_corr-sum_larvacount) ~ -1+CrossType , data=dat, ziformula=~1 +CrossType, dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial())
summary(msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2)

## AICc
MuMIn::model.sel(msat_bin_nozi, msat_bin_zi, msat_bin_zi_CrossType, msat_betabin_nozi, msat_betabin_zi, msat_betabin_zi_CrossType, msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2) 

## Check convergence
m <- msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2
c(conv = m$fit$convergence, pdHess = m$sdr$pdHess)

## 0-60% of zeros comes from the zero inflation (the rest comes from the betabibomial)
plogis(glmmTMB::fixef(m)$zi)          

so <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m, n = 1000)
## Check that residuals are close to the diagonal
plot(so)

## No remaining zero inflation
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(so)

obs0 <- tapply(dat$sum_larvacount == 0, dat$CrossType, sum)
sim0 <- apply(so$simulatedResponse == 0, 2,
             function(z) tapply(z, dat$CrossType, sum))

cbind(observed = obs0,
       expected = round(rowMeans(sim0), 1),
       lo95     = apply(sim0, 1, quantile, 0.025),
       hi95     = apply(sim0, 1, quantile, 0.975))

## Check residuals for the homogeneity in variance
round(tapply(residuals(so), dat$CrossType, var), 3)   # more variation with Bal males
## Levene Test
DHARMa::testCategorical(so, catPred = factor(dat$CrossType))
## OK with different dispersion parameters phi for Bal vs. am males
```

## Best model estimate
```{r}
## cross type effect on hatch rate and mating probability
m <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1+CrossType, ziformula=~-1 +CrossType, dispformula = ~ -1+ CrossType, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)
summary(m)
logLik(m)
logLik(msat_betabin_zi_CrossType2)

## Compute observed hatch rate
datCrossType <- dat |>
  dplyr::group_by(CrossType) |>
  dplyr::summarise(Sum_eggcount_corr = sum(sum_eggcount_corr),
                   Sum_larvacount = sum(sum_larvacount))|>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = Sum_larvacount / Sum_eggcount_corr)

## Zero-inflated part of the model
## Probability of having no mating
tapply(predict(m, type="zprob"), dat$CrossType, mean)
(p1 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m)$zi)))

## Predicted hatch rate
tapply(predict(m, type="conditional"), dat$CrossType, mean)
(p2 <-1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m)$cond)))

## Combined probability (1-prob_no_mating) x hatch rate
tapply(predict(m, type="response"), dat$CrossType, mean)
(1-p1)*p2

## Observed hatch rate
tapply(dat$sum_larvacount, dat$CrossType, sum)/tapply(dat$sum_eggcount_corr, dat$CrossType, sum)

## Extract precision parameter
tapply(predict(m, type="disp"), dat$CrossType, mean)
phi <- exp(glmmTMB::fixef(m)$disp)

## Compute overdispersion
rho <- 1 / (phi + 1)
## Check precision and overdispersion parameters
round(rbind(phi = phi, rho = rho), 3)

# Standard deviation of p (the hatch probability) among males higher among Bal males than among Am males
mu <- plogis(glmmTMB::fixef(m)$cond)
round(sqrt(mu * (1 - mu) * rho), 3)

```

# Test function fit_ZI_Beta_binomial
## Model selection for crosses with Bal 
```{r}

## Null model
m0 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ 1, ziformula=~1, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)

## CI model
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ CI_test, ziformula=~1, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)

## Saturated model
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1+CrossType, ziformula=~-1 +CrossType, dispformula = ~ 1, family=glmmTMB::betabinomial(), weights = sum_eggcount_corr, data=dat)

MuMIn::model.sel(m0, m1, m2)
summary(m1)

## Compute confidence interval for m3
## Refit model nsim times
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m2, FUN=function(fit) extract_model(fit, estimateCI = TRUE, estimate_response=TRUE, estimate_overdisp=TRUE, newdata=dat), nsim=5, .progress="txt")
  
## Extract 95% CIs
confint <- data.frame(bCI_tab(b=b1))

```

# Make Fig. 1
## Fit for Fig. 1 with Bal, Trento, Par6 and Rennes 
```{r}
## List of lines
europe <- unique(merged_data$Male[merged_data$Female=="Am"&merged_data$Male!="Am"])
europe <- europe[c(1, 2, 3, 11)]

## Dataframe with all the lines
crosses <- data.frame(continent=rep("Europe", 4), uninf_strain="Am" , inf_strain=c("Trento", "Bal", "Rennes", "Par6"))

## Fit all models on all the crosses function with nbootsim = 500
results <- apply(crosses, 1, fit_ZI_Beta_binomial, data=merged_data, nbootsim = 500, dec_places=3, zis = list(zi1  = ~ 1), disps = list(disp1  = ~ 1), saturated_model_estimates="m2_zi1_disp1")

## Extract the results from all models
crossnum <- 1:nrow(crosses)

confintp1 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp1"))

confintp2 <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintp2"))

AICC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="modelaicc"))

overdisp <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintdisp"))

CI <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="confintCI"))

block <- do.call(rbind, lapply(crossnum, FUN=extract_results, outputper_infstrain=results, parameter="block"))

## Add AmxAm
names(block)[names(block)=="output.parameter...1.."] <- "block"
block <- rbind(block, c("Europe", "Am", "Control", "1", "1_2_5_6_7"))

## Export files
write.table(x = AICC, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_model_AICc.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp1, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_confintp1.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = confintp2, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_confintp2.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = overdisp, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_overdisp.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
write.table(x = CI, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_CI_estimates.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Prepare observed and fitted data for Figure 1
```{r}

#Load fitted hatch rate excluding structural zeros
fitted_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "TableS2_confintp2.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Remove duplicated AmxAm
fitted_data <- fitted_data |>
  dplyr::filter(!duplicated(CrossType))

# Add Pair
fitted_data <- fitted_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Pair = as.character(CrossType) |>
      sub(pattern = "^(.+)x\\1$", replacement = "\\1") |>   # XxX     -> X
      sub(pattern = "^Amx|xAm$",  replacement = "")    |>   # AmxX, XxAm -> X
      dplyr::recode(Am = "Control")                         # AmxAm   -> Control
  )|>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair = factor(Pair, levels = c("Control", "Trento", "Bal", "Par6", "Rennes")))

#Load observed hatch rate
observed_data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

## Cross to used for observed hatch rate
#crosses <- c("AmxAm", "BalxBal", "AmxBal", "BalxAm", "TrentoxTrento", "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "RennesxAm", "AmxRennes", "RennesxRennes", "AmxPar6","Par6xPar6", "Par6xAm")
u <- unique(crosses$uninf_strain)              # "Am"
strain_order <- crosses$inf_strain                # or e.g. c("Bal", "Trento", "Rennes", "Par6")
cross_order <- c(paste0(u, "x", u),
                 unlist(lapply(strain_order, \(s) c(paste0(u, "x", s),     # AmxS (test cross)
                                                    paste0(s, "x", u),     # SxAm
                                                    paste0(s, "x", s)))))  # SxS

cross_order
# Filter only data frot eh plot
observed_data <- observed_data |>
  dplyr::filter(CrossType %in% cross_order)|>
  dplyr::mutate(Year=as.factor(Year))

## Change order for the CrosstypesLabel
desired_order2 <- c(
    "AmxAm", 
    "AmxTrento", "TrentoxAm", "TrentoxTrento",
    "AmxBal", "BalxAm","BalxBal",
    "AmxRennes", "RennesxAm", "RennesxRennes",
    "AmxPar6", "Par6xAm", "Par6xPar6")

labs <- unique(fitted_data$CrossTypeLabel)
cross_of_lab <- sub(" \\(.*$", "", labs)                 # "AmxAm (59)" -> "AmxAm"
lab_levels <- labs[order(match(cross_of_lab, desired_order2))]

fitted_data <- fitted_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossTypeLabel = factor(CrossTypeLabel, levels = lab_levels))

## Add the CrossTypeLabel with the right number of replicates
observed_data <- observed_data |>
  dplyr::rename(CrossTypeLabelold=CrossTypeLabel)|>
  dplyr::left_join(fitted_data[, c("Pair","CrossTypeLabel", "CrossType")], by="CrossType")

# One row per infected strain and allowed batch
blocks <- block |>
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = strsplit(block, "_")) |>
  tidyr::unnest(Batch) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Batch = as.integer(Batch)) |>
  dplyr::select(infstrain, Batch)|>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair_block=paste(infstrain, Batch, sep="_"))|>
  dplyr::select(infstrain, Pair_block)

## 45 Petri dishes not used for the figure
observed_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair_block=paste(Pair, Batch, sep="_")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(blocks, by = "Pair_block") |>
  dplyr::filter(is.na(infstrain)) 

## Remove the 45 Petri dishes not used
observed_data <- observed_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Pair_block=paste(Pair, Batch, sep="_")) |>
  dplyr::left_join(blocks, by = "Pair_block") |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(infstrain)) 
```

## Plot Figure 1
```{r}
#Create bar plot with individual data points
hatchrateplot1 <- fitted_data |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = Estimate, fill = Cross)) +
  ggplot2::geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(ggplot2::aes(ymin = X2.5., ymax = X97.5.), width = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(data = observed_data, aes(x = CrossTypeLabel, y = hatchrate, color = Year), position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0), size =3) + 
  ggplot2::geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate), y=1.1), vjust = 1.5, position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), size = 10) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Control cross 1 W- x W-" = "#00bfc4", "Test cross W- x W+" = "#F8766D", "Control cross 2 W+ x W-" = "#7cae00", "Control cross 3 W+ x W+" = "#c77cff")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c ("2023" = "#931F1D", "2024" = "#00008B")) + 
  labs(x = "Cross", y = "Hatch rate", title = "Observed hatch rate and fitted hatch rate excluding structural zeros for each cross (female strain x male strain)", fill = "Cross type") +
  ggh4x::facet_nested(~Pair, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  theme_grey(base_size = 30) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20, "pt"),
        #strip.background = element_blank(),  # Removes background from facet labels
        strip.placement = "outside", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size=30, angle = 45, hjust = 1), #modify the text of the axis x
        axis.text=element_text(size=20),
        title = element_text(size = 0), #face="bold" makes it bold
        axis.title=element_text(size=35,face="bold"),
        legend.text=element_text(size = 30),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 30),
        legend.position = "top",
        strip.text.x = element_text(size =45),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linetype = "dotted", color = "grey")) + # text for the subtitles/strips
        theme(
          panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
          legend.position = "top"
          )+ylim(0, 1.1)


#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Fig1.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   hatchrateplot1, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 100/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```
